module: Node "Concat" (simple, OBSOLETE: "Use the Format String node instead"). Concatenates all its inputs (converted by tostring) into a string. A new pin value<N+1> is added automatically when the last one is linked and the empty pins at the end of the list are removed. nil or false values are ignored.
notes: false values are ignored: booleans must be converted manually (todo in the file).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

init.desc: Output at '', empty input cache, savePins = true.

updateCache.desc: Rebuilds the string cache from the input pins and indicates whether it changed.

work.desc: Recomputes the output with table.concat(cache) if the cache changed.

onLink.desc: Hook: when a link is created, cleans up the pins.

onUnlink.desc: Hook: when a link is deleted, cleans up the pins.

cleanupPins.desc: Keeps exactly one empty pin at the end of the list (creates one or removes the excess).
